title: helianthemum apenninum var. roseum
intro: Helianthemum apenninum var. roseum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Cistaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for treating pain and anxiety. Bioactive constituents of Helianthemum apenninum var. roseum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
